evidence.title: Iron Mountain Q2 2026 - selected US physical construction rows
evidence.excerpt: The June 30 development table places VA-9 Phase 1, VA-9 Phase 2, MIA-1 and NJE-1 in construction rows with positive Q2 investment. VA-9's two phases belong to one campus; this source package selects Phase 1 only.

metadata.content_hash_scope: SHA-256 of exact decoded HTTP response-body bytes
metadata.capture_time_scope: UTC clock readings bracket the request or its concurrent capture group; retrieved_at is observed group completion, not an invented HTTP server timestamp.
metadata.rights_scope: Compact factual summaries only; raw documents, HTML, source code, plans, images and map tiles remain temporary and are not redistributed. No open media-reuse permission is inferred.
metadata.section: Page 23 Data Center Expansion and Development Activity; page 2 dates figures to the quarter ended June 30 unless otherwise noted.
metadata.publication_date_basis: The same raw source's page 3 press-release dateline is August 5, 2026. Page 2 states all figures are for the quarter ended June 30, 2026 unless noted. Neither is September retrieval.
excluded_rows: AZP-3 Phase 3 is absent from the construction table and AZP-3 is listed stabilized in the operating table; the stale Q1 construction selection is not refreshed.
CHI-1 Future Phases carries footnote (1), planned but not commenced, and is excluded.
VA Future Phases has no facility identity or positive Q2 investment in its row; no physical-site allocation is attempted.
All portfolio totals, held-development rows, operating capacity and non-US rows are excluded from this US source package.
metadata.status_scope: Generic under_construction only. Table megawatts and investment identify rows, not normalized capacity or measured load. Forecast quarters are not observed completion.
metadata.capture_note: A generic curl request returned 403; the transparent research User-Agent request succeeded and reproduced the earlier source hash. Failed responses are not evidence.

unselected_same_campus_row.reason: Same campus as selected Phase 1; not a second site or normalized second project in this package.

metadata.nje1_successor_scope: Q1's NJE-1 row was footnoted as planned but not commenced. Q2's exact NJE-1 row has no such marker and reports positive Q2 and cumulative construction investment; it supports generic June 30 under_construction only.
metadata.normalization_guardrail: Table MW, monetary investment, forecast quarters, preleases and operating-portfolio values identify/explain the rows only. No capacity, workload, operator role, tenant, customer, operating status or exact completion date is normalized.
